concept_label: Household expenditure on decorating or renovating houses (past year, 2011/2013)
domain: household economic resources and housing investment
unit: nominal Yuan spent in the past year
construct: household-level expenditure; past-year house decorating/renovating (furniture excluded)
mapping_status: candidate; official questionnaire and Codebook identify field; verify response routing and special codes in authorized data
caveat: Household-level reported expenditure, not individual income, house value, maintenance quality, or total housing investment. Do not combine with remodeling/rebuilding questions that explicitly exclude decoration. Keep nominal amounts wave-specific unless a price-adjustment protocol is prespecified. 2015 Codebook lists ha025 as No Observations, so 2015 is deliberately not mapped as observed.
